name: Varogan
body:
These reptilian humanoids are thickly corded with muscle, with blunted heads and wide-set, beady eyes. Their eyes are placed wider to be more vigilant for predators., though they can be predators themselves. Varogans have many redundant organs due to their dangerous home planet and they have humps on their backs that store nutrients and water for long periods of time. That coupled with their decreased need for constant water makes them hardy in harsh environments. They are also highly resistant to poisons and diseases stemming from their harsh environs. This also means that Varogans, when not killed by unnatural means, can live for an extremely long time. The longest recorded lifespan for a varogan was an ancient emperor that lived for other 1,000 years before being killed in an honor duel.

Varogans are a highly aggressive culture because their harsh environment required them to be. They are extremely competent warriors and have been known to fly into a blood frenzy in the heat of combat. Varogan spellcasters are rare, but those that develop innate magic tend to be very powerful.

Varogans are hard-headed but loyal and make steadfast allies, or persistent enemies. Relations: Varogans are highly aggressive and gruff which can make relations difficult to develop upon first contact. From there cultures tend to make enemies with only stalemates keeping the lines between them, or stalwart allies willing to go to war for their protection.

Alignment and Religion: Varogans do not have strong religious beliefs, but they have a highly ritualistic society for the living and their dead. Many ceremonies and holidays are centered around making war, births, seasons, and burying the dead. Some varogans develop religion upon exposure to other cultures and gravitate toward faiths of war, retribution, and strength.

Adventurers: Varogans love conquest, fighting, and adventure and as such can be commonly found as lone adventurers, or with groups of trusted allies.

Core Traits
Ability Score Modifiers: Varogans are hardy and physically powerful, but are short tempered. They gain a +2 Strength and Constitution but a -2 Wisdom.
Size: Varogans are Medium creatures and thus receive no bonuses or penalties due to their size.
Type: Varogans are Humanoids with the varogan subtype.
Base Speed: Varogans have a base speed of 30 feet.
Languages: Varogans begin play speaking varogan. Varogans with high Intelligence scores can choose from common, draconic, dwarven, or salucian.
Fearless: Varogans gain a +2 bonus on saving throws against fear effects.
Natural Armor: Turnal gain a +1 natural armor bonus to their Armor Class.
Robust: Varogans gain a +2 bonus on saving throws against poison and disease effects.
Keen Sight: Turnal gain a +2 bonus on sight?based Perception checks.
Ferocity: If the hit points of a varogan falls below 0 but they are not yet dead, they can continue to fight. If they do, they ate staggered, and lose 1 hit point each round. They still die when their hit points reach a negative amount equal to their Constitution score.
Low-Light Vision: Varogans can see twice as far as a race with normal vision in conditions of dim light.
Other Traits
Storage Hump: Varogans can survive four times as long as a human without food or water.
Blood Frenzy: Some varogans fall into a blood frenzy, but find themselves physically spent sooner in battle. Once per day, they can fly into a frenzy for 1 minute. They gain a +2 bonus to Constitution and Strength, but a -2 penalty to AC. However, their ferocity only lasts 1 round. If they are not healed above 0 hit points after the 1 round, they fall unconscious.
Inborn Caster: Some varogans are born with innate magical capacity. They are less strong than their counterparts but have a stronger personality. The gain a +2 Constitution, +2 Charisma, and a -2 Wisdom. They also gain a +2 bonus on concentration checks to cast defensively. Varogans can take this trait in place of their normal ability score modifiers.
Relentless: Some varogans made to charge and run down their enemies. They gain a +2 bonus on combat maneuver checks made to bull rush and overrun an opponent, so long as both are on the ground. A varogan can take this trait in place of fearless.
Sterilized: Varogans were looked at as too dangerous if allowed to continue to reproduce and grow. As such, some varogans were rendered unable to reproduce by those with powerful magics.
Survivalist: Some varogans are trained for survival and tracking. Hey are less focused on the vigilance and direct combat of their peers. They gain a +1 bonus on Knowledge (nature) and Survival checks. Varogans can take this trait in place of fearless and keen sight.
